title: Unit
description: The unit record in .pairingbuddy/run/unit.json: a branch and the task records that accumulate on it.

type.description: The branch type pb unit open was given (feat, fix, chore, refactor, spike): the guess of the task type before intake, which pb run open checks the runners against. May be absent (units opened before it).

configAcceptances.description: The test-config changes the human accepted with pb human accept while the unit was open, oldest first; configHash is the last newHash. May be absent (none accepted).

questions.description: Questions for you: the doubts a gate passed under the auto policy set aside instead of stopping the run, oldest first, at most 20 in full. The human may answer any of them at any time (pb human answer, /pb-answer); G:publish asks the ones still open, lists the answered ones as handled, and its approval clears them. May be absent (none).

answer.description: The human's answer, from pb human answer or /pb-answer; the question then no longer counts as open.

settled.description: How the session settled the answer at the next task boundary: rework (a rework task was added to the plan) or keep (it only guides the work to come).

rework.description: The title of the rework task a settled-as-rework answer added to the plan.

questionsMore.description: How many more deferred doubts came past the 20 kept in full; their text stays in the kept runs' gate records. May be absent (none).

lenses.description: The task ledger's lens records when the task ended (the safety-net record: stage, attempt, lenses, counts, uncovered names); absent when none was written.

fullSuite.description: The task ledger's full-suite result when the task ended; null when none was run.
